diagnostics.relative_offset_definition: Mean of tile A minus tile B over the mean of the two tile means, shared pixels. Left out below 100 pixels or when the mean level is 50 units or less.
diagnostics.status: post-run diagnostics from stored statistics, never rules

endpoints.catalog_queries: none. Items come from the saved stage 4 catalogs.
endpoints.payer: Bucket owners. Every request was unsigned, so no requester was charged. A requester-pays bucket refuses unsigned requests.

limitations: Two acquisitions, 2025-10-15 at Lake Lanier and 2025-10-31 at Lake Okeechobee, and the lakes of probe T6's stage 4 plan. Pairs across UTM zones are listed and not compared.
Each option is compared with itself. A tile disagreement is a difference in processing, not an error of either tile, and ranks neither correction, assumption A52.
Overlap pixels sit near tile edges, where each tile's processing has less context. The result describes those pixels, not tile interiors.
Collection 1 10 m bands are averaged to 20 m and B01 takes its 60 m parent, rule P3. The same resampling applies to both tiles of a pair.
Pixel classes come from NHD polygons, whose shorelines are not observations of a date.
Pooled statistics are pixel observations summed over pairs. Lake Okeechobee dominates them. The summary also splits by pair, and pixels are not independent.
GDAL requests and bytes are byte ranges requested, from its debug log. Laptop over the internet, outside us-west-2, assumption A25. Times are not production estimates.
No pixel value is stored. Only counts and statistics.
network: The owner's laptop over the internet, outside us-west-2, assumption A25. Transfer times include that path.

tolerances.O1_pairs: Probe T6's stage 4 plan fixes the regions, acquisitions, products, and member lakes. Two tiles of one region form a pair when they share a UTM zone and a member lake. Pairs across zones are listed and not compared. Each tile's Sen2Cor source is the Collection 1 item its product was paired with, from the saved Level-2A stage 4 catalog.
tolerances.O2_grid: Both tiles declare the same CRS. Their 20 m origins differ by a whole number of pixels within 1e-06 pixel. Every layer read sits on its own tile's grid within 1e-06 pixel at its resolution. A pair that fails leaves every comparison. When the offset is not a whole number of 60 m pixels, B01 leaves the Sen2Cor comparison, because its 60 m parents would cover different ground.
tolerances.O3_pixels: Pixel classes come from each lake's exact polygon on the shared 20 m grid, masks version 2, interior, shoreline, and near-land. Overlap pixels lie inside both tiles.
tolerances.O4_units: Values are integers of 1e-04 reflectance. Product values are used as stored. Collection 1 values are the stored integer times the declared scale plus the declared offset, with rule P3's resampling for 10 m and 60 m bands. Both Collection 1 items of a pair must declare one scale and offset per band. Differences are tile A minus tile B, tiles in name order.
tolerances.O5_comparable: Within one option, a pixel is comparable in a band when both tiles hold data, rule P5's no-data values. The shared set holds the pixels comparable in both options.
tolerances.O6_strata: Per option, band, and pixel class. Four subsets: all comparable pixels, own clear water where the option's own flags call the pixel clear water in both tiles, the shared set, and shared clear water, clear by both options' flags in both tiles. ACOLITE clear water is a decoded flag integer of 0. Sen2Cor clear water is scene class 6.
tolerances.O7_tile_agreement: A pixel disagrees when its two tiles differ by more than 50 units, 0.005 reflectance. An option's tiles agree in a band, class, and subset when at least 90% of its pixels do not disagree. A stratum with fewer than 100 pixels gets no verdict. Pooled over pairs and lakes.
tolerances.O8_widening: On the shared and shared clear-water sets, ACOLITE widens tile disagreement in a band and class when its share beyond 0.005 exceeds Sen2Cor's by more than 5 percentage points. It narrows it when Sen2Cor's share exceeds ACOLITE's by more than that. Otherwise the two are similar. This compares consistency across tiles. It says nothing about accuracy, assumption A52.
tolerances.O9_flag_diagnostic: Diagnostic only, never a rule. Per option and class, the share of overlap pixels whose quality code differs between the two tiles: the decoded ACOLITE flag integer, and the scene classification class.
